movie.title: Murder Game
movie.overview: Three years ago, assassin Tide betrayed her organization by refusing to carry out a kill order. After escaping death, she adopted the alias Minghui and lived in seclusion in a small town with her blind sister Mingzhu, running a coffee shop. An accident exposes their whereabouts, and former accomplices track them down, catching Mingzhu in a manhunt. To save her sister, Chao Xi is forced to return to the killing game, and her hidden identity is revealed amidst the gunfire.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When her quiet life in hiding is shattered, a former assassin is forced to return to her deadly past to save her kidnapped sister.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Three years after defying her organization, former assassin Tide lives peacefully as Minghui, running a small-town coffee shop with her blind sister, Mingzhu. However, an accidental slip-up reveals her location, prompting her ruthless ex-accomplices to hunt them down and take Mingzhu hostage. Forced back into a violent world she tried to escape, Tide must reclaim her lethal skills and face her former comrades in a fight for survival.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Three years ago, a top assassin known as Tide broke code and betrayed her syndicate by refusing to execute a kill order. Narrowly escaping with her life, she shed her former identity, assumed the alias Minghui, and vanished into a quiet small town. There, she built a peaceful life running a coffee shop alongside her blind sister, Mingzhu, hoping her violent past would remain buried. However, an unexpected accident accidentally exposes her whereabouts to the syndicate, which swiftly dispatches her former accomplices to eliminate her. In the ensuing chaotic manhunt, Mingzhu is captured by the killers, leaving Minghui with no choice but to step back into the dark underworld. To rescue her sister, she re-enters the deadly game she fled, taking up arms once more. Amidst fierce gun battles and escalating violence, her true identity as the legendary assassin Tide is exposed. Pushed to the edge, she must confront her past, outsmart her former allies, and kill her way through the organization to secure a future for herself and Mingzhu.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: After refusing to execute a kill order, elite assassin Tide betrayed her ruthless organization and narrowly escaped death. Seeking redemption and peace, she adopted the name Minghui and settled in a quiet small town with her blind sister, Mingzhu, where they ran a modest coffee shop. For three years, her past remained buried, but an unexpected accident exposes their location to her former employers. When her ex-accomplices descend on the town and target her sister, Minghui is forced to unleash her hidden lethal skills. To save Mingzhu, she must re-enter the high-stakes game of survival, where old debts are settled in gunfire and her true identity can no longer remain hidden.

story_structure.climax: Tide faces off against her pursuers in a high-stakes firefight where her true identity is exposed, forcing her to unleash her full assassin skill set to rescue Mingzhu.
story_structure.conflict: An unexpected accident reveals Tide's location to her former organization. Ruthless ex-accomplices track her down and capture Mingzhu, thrusting Tide back into danger.
story_structure.resolution: With the immediate threat neutralized and her hidden past laid bare, Tide and Mingzhu must contend with the fallout of the bloody confrontation and determine their future.
story_structure.introduction: Tide, a former assassin, escapes her dangerous past and adopts the alias Minghui. She settles into a quiet life running a coffee shop in a small town alongside her blind sister, Mingzhu.
story_structure.risingAction: Desperate to save her sister, Tide is forced to re-enter the deadly world she abandoned, navigating treacherous traps and confronting hunting parties dispatched by her old syndicate.
